tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the backend README to see the scope: Laravel API, auth, marketplace logic, workers, storage, and AI integration.

tour.title: Bootstrap and Kernels
tour.description: Read the bootstrap and kernel files to understand how the Laravel application is assembled and which services are bound first.

tour.title: Marketplace Package
tour.description: The Marvel package is the real backend engine: its main service provider wires GraphQL, REST, events, broadcasts, and configuration.

tour.title: API Surfaces
tour.description: Inspect the REST route file and GraphQL schema to see the two primary API entry points for products, orders, users, and integrations.

tour.title: Domain Model
tour.description: Follow the controllers, listeners, events, payment adapters, and notifications to understand how marketplace actions move through the domain.

tour.title: Data and Verification
tour.description: Finish with migrations, seeders, and the UpgradeSafetyTest to see the persistence layer and the guardrails around framework upgrades.
